info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Service Validation API
info.description: The Service Validation API facilitates the validation of service directory entries across multiple banking channels. It allows authorized users to submit service validation requests for specific services identified by parameters. This API is essential for maintaining data integrity and verifying the accuracy of service information. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers who need to ensure their service listings are up-to-date and accurate. This streamlined process supports efficient cross-channel banking operations.
